name: Church Town of Gammelstad, Luleå
description: Just north of Luleå in Swedish Lappland's coastal reaches, Gammelstad is a village that was built for Sundays. Hundreds of small wooden houses, mostly painted red, cluster around a stone church from the early 1400s. Farming families from distant parishes stayed in them during services and festivals, since the long journey home couldn't be made in a day. It is the best-preserved village of its kind in northern Scandinavia.
